profile.businessSummary: Indian Energy Exchange provides a nationwide, automated trading platform, facilitating the physical delivery of electricity, renewable energy, and valuable certificates across the country. Its guiding vision is to be the architect of next-generation solutions for sustainable energy, ensuring competitive, transparent, and reliable access for a developing nation. The company's core mission is to leverage technology and innovation to establish an efficient marketplace, delivering affordable and dependable energy to all consumers. Through its exchange platform, IEX enables efficient price discovery and increases the accessibility and transparency of the power market, enhancing trade execution speed. IEX has registered over 7,900 participants, including a diverse range of stakeholders like DISCOMs, energy generators, industries, and ESCerts entities, solidifying its position. Demonstrating robust growth, IEX achieved traded volumes of 110 billion units in FY'24, which is a significant 13.8% increase over the previous year.

news.title: IEX is actively evaluating a share buyback to deploy surplus cash and enhance shareholder value amid investor scrutiny. Management is assessing capital allocation options following tax policy changes, though no definitive buyback timeline has been provided.

IEX expects power demand to hit 2,700 BU by 2032, while awaiting approvals for several new trading segments. The exchange plans coal and carbon trading diversification and reducing its IGX stake to 25% by December 2026.

IEX reported a 12.9% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹139.2 crore for the quarter ended September 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations grew 8.6% YoY to ₹167.1 crore, with total income reaching ₹203 crore.
IEX's board will meet on October 29, 2026, to consider and approve unaudited Q2 financial results. The trading window is closed and will reopen 48 hours after the declaration of financial results.

SEBI approved four IPOs including Cult.fit, Sohan Lal Commodity Management, Eswari Global Metal Industries, and Indian Gas Exchange. Cult.fit plans a Rs 950 crore fresh issue, while IEX-promoted Indian Gas Exchange will conduct an OFS.

SEBI approved Indian Gas Exchange's IPO, comprising an offer for sale of up to 1.7 crore shares by promoter IEX. As a pure offer for sale, IGX receives no proceeds, helping IEX cut its stake from over 47% to 25%.
Bernstein has upgraded IEX, expecting delayed market coupling to reduce near-term business pressures.
IEX power prices doubled in September driven by a sharp surge in demand.
Bernstein has issued an upgrade on Indian Energy Exchange (IEX) on Live TV. Following the upgrade, IEX stock initially rose by about half a percent and was later reported trading up 1.5%.
IEX shares have received an upgrade. Bernstein cautions about weak volume growth ahead.
